function wrap<T,U>(fn: (value:T) => U): (value:T) => U {
  return value => fn(value);
}
function id<T>(value:T):T { return value; }
function compose<A,B,C>(first: (a:A) => B, second: (b:B) => C): (a:A) => C {
  return a => second(first(a));
}
function array<T>(x:T):T[] { return [x]; }
function box<T>(x:T):{value:T} { return {value:x}; }
const generic = wrap(id);
const n: number = generic(1);
const s: string = generic('text');
const composed = compose(array, box);
const a: string[] = composed('hello').value;
const b: number[] = composed(2).value;
const keyed = wrap(<T extends { key: string }>(value:T) => value);
const k: number = keyed({ key: 'known', count: 3 }).count;
function pair<A,B,C,D>(first: (a:A) => B, second: (c:C) => D): (a:A, c:C) => [B,D] {
  return (a,c) => [first(a), second(c)];
}
const p: [number, string] = pair(id, id)(4, 'last');
console.log(n, s, a[0], b[0], k, ...p);
class Box<T> {
  constructor(public value: T) {}
}
function wrapConstructor<A, B>(ctor: new (value: A) => B): new (value: A) => B {
  return ctor;
}
const WrappedBox = wrapConstructor(Box);
const constructed: string = new WrappedBox('constructor').value;
console.log(constructed);
